info.comment: Download Please.Classic Mario Bros game Remade for GBA remade as an infinite game for scratch. Just seeing if I can still use the program. ;)Controls: Arrow keys to move mario. Bump the ground below shellcreepers to knock them over, then run into them to kick them off. Wait too long and they get back up.I'm planning to release prototypes of games and stuff here so expect nothing really big. :PSummer fans, enjoy:http://www.stencyl.net/embed/index.php?gameID=1776Also, please love this project:http://scratch.mit.edu/projects/floatingmagictree/1484139For my dear friend FMT. He has a fever. And the only cure. Is more. LOVEIT.
